parts:

For example, two of the functions to simulate data (create_test_acc_csv, create_test_sleeplog_csv) are in the description but not on the package. Or am I missing something? messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Data, vignettes, and simulated data
parts:
Those two functions are for developers only, which is why I did not add them to the package namespace. I should have clarified this in the documentation.

If you are a developer and want to explore the tests, then you will need to work with the code directly (available on GitHub).
If you need an example file to explore GGIR then it is better to get a real example file, because create_test_acc_csv  creates a very artificial file that is nothing more than a trick to test core functions of GGIR quickly without having to load a lot of data. This is only for development purposes and not intended as demo material.

Vincent
